correctness.rationale: Strict supporting lines make exactly min(N_i,2) extreme sampled points per occupied side. Multinomial generating function and binomial mean identities follow. The positive sum of finite exponential-polynomial terms allows exact dominant q and multiplicity extraction, iterated finitely. Real Jacobian rank two at a regular equilateral m-gon gives an (m−3)-dimensional local closure family and strictly convex noncongruent witnesses. Standalone Python checker reproduced 16 exact mean cases and 10000 geometric hull identities; the proof does not rely on simulations.

value.rationale: Complete classification of what combinatorial boundary hull sampling can and cannot identify. Constructive exact recovery of all normalized side-length masses and sharp similarity-reconstruction cutoff m=3, together with positive-dimensional m≥4 counterfamilies, resolve a natural geometric inverse problem. Does not claim noise stability or finite sample reconstruction.
